name: PR/SET domain 6
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRDM6 encodes putative histone-lysine N-methyltransferase PRDM6. Annotated molecular activities include histone H4K20 monomethyltransferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of gene expression.
